fonts.name: Ledger
fonts.why: A soft, slightly wonky serif for headings over a sturdy humanist text face: trustworthy without feeling corporate.

fonts.name: Signal
fonts.why: Quirky geometric headings give character to dense, data-heavy screens that Inter keeps legible.

fonts.name: Workshop
fonts.why: Characterful headings and a friendly, open text face: a tool that feels made by people.

fonts.name: Atlas
fonts.why: An elegant condensed serif for large headlines; quiet sans text lets it carry the page.

fonts.name: Plex
fonts.why: One family with a matching mono: engineered, neutral and consistent from tables to code.

fonts.name: Masthead
fonts.why: A newsroom grotesk: confident headings and compact, readable text in one family.

fonts.name: Harbor
fonts.why: Clean, slightly rounded geometry that reads calm and modern in dashboards and settings.

fonts.name: Meadow
fonts.why: Round, approachable headings with an easy text face: consumer apps and onboarding.

fonts.name: Gazette
fonts.why: High-contrast display serif from the same design family as its sans: classic editorial with a modern body.

fonts.name: Orbit
fonts.why: Wide geometric headings feel precise and forward-looking; Inter keeps the interface dense and clear.

fonts.name: Terminal
fonts.why: Sharp, minimal and developer-native, with a mono that matches the sans exactly.

fonts.name: Quarterly
fonts.why: A reading serif made for screens with a neutral civic sans: considered and credible.

fonts.name: Premiere
fonts.why: Dramatic, high-contrast headlines for a landing page that should feel premium.

fonts.name: Foundry
fonts.why: A robust grotesk with industrial roots: strong headings, efficient body, no frills.

fonts.name: Poster
fonts.why: An expressive display face for one loud moment per page; Inter calms everything else.

fonts.name: Sprout
fonts.why: Clean and friendly with excellent small-size legibility: forms, lists and mobile screens.

fonts.name: Breeze
fonts.why: A polished contemporary sans that feels fresh in both product UI and marketing.

fonts.name: Clarity
fonts.why: Designed for reading fluency: generous widths for audiences where clarity beats density.

fonts.name: Timber
fonts.why: A sturdy slab for headings feels grounded and crafted; a humanist sans keeps text easy.

fonts.name: Almanac
fonts.why: A bookish old-style serif with a characterful grotesk: thoughtful, literary, warm.

fonts.name: Manifesto
fonts.why: Heavy, tight headlines that make a point; the same family stays readable in text.

fonts.name: Optical
fonts.classification: superfamily: display, text and mono cuts
fonts.why: Separate display and text cuts of one superfamily: optical sizes done properly, plus a matching mono.

fonts.name: Civic
fonts.why: A dependable gothic: neutral, institutional and highly legible at every size.

fonts.name: Launch
fonts.why: Wide, playful display type for a hero that should feel energetic; Manrope keeps the rest tidy.

fonts.name: Hearth
fonts.why: A chunky, warm serif adds homeliness to headings without slowing down a practical UI.

fonts.name: Salon
fonts.why: Refined Garamond headings over a humanist sans: luxury, hospitality and craft.

fonts.name: Playground
fonts.why: Slightly rounded corners make everything feel soft and playful; good for consumer and education apps.

fonts.name: Nordic
fonts.why: Restrained and even: lets colour and content lead in calm, minimal interfaces.

fonts.name: Bureau
fonts.why: A grotesk with a light humanist touch: professional but not cold.

fonts.name: Essay
fonts.why: A serif drawn for screens gives content pages a literary voice while the UI stays sans.

fonts.name: Console
fonts.why: Monospaced headings signal a developer tool at a glance; Inter keeps prose readable.

fonts.name: Loam
fonts.why: A gently calligraphic serif with a plain grotesk: natural, organic, unhurried.

scale.1.2: apps: tight steps for dense screens

shells.sidebar-app: Persistent left navigation, top bar, content area. Dashboards and tools.
shells.topbar-app: Top navigation bar, centred content. Simple apps and settings-heavy products.
shells.marketing: Header, full-width sections, footer. Landing and content pages.

props.subtitle: one line under it
props.actions: button labels; the first is the primary action

props.stats: [{label, value, delta?}] — the 3–5 numbers that matter
